report.notes: R6-01: root cause (flat unordered numeral sets) replaced: numerals chained by -, /, :, en/em dash, ' - ' or ' to ' become one ordered compound token (ISO/D-M-Y dates canonicalised, written D/M order kept, month-name dates one value; dates also yield year and month-day, two-value ranges also their endpoints); class-level swap regressions for verify and find_conflicts over every separator. Existing exact-set test tests/web/test_w1_r5_review_regressions.py ('COVID-19 cases in 2019-2020') updated to include the new ordered token '2019-2020' (still exact equality). Number-to-referent binding not fixed; documented as L-W1-6. R6-03: find_conflicts skips instruction-like and link/contact sentences; surface.clean masks links/e-mail/IP in web-derived text (host/path citation label kept); instruction-like titles and conflict pairs hidden. R6-02: short-code value accepts up to 4 space-separated groups (3-32 chars total); cvd/csv/cid/cav2 added in Python and snapshot.js (patterns string-identical); single-digit 'Digit n' OTP boxes remain a documented residual (L-A0-2). Docs: recorded corrections for W1-AC10/AC11/AC15 and A0-AC7. Gates: tests/web + tests/assist 2556 passed; baseline 08a4569 export with new tests: 135 failed / 50 passed (the passing ones are controls). tests/phase2a/test_frozen_core.py base-commit check fails the same way on the 08a4569 export (not caused here). graphify update not run (graphify-out outside permitted paths).
